archive.title: Astral Vanguards
archive.summary: Outsiders who recognize recurring pressures across worlds—and risk confusing understanding with authority.
archive.provenance: Extracted as a separate ontological layer from the hybrid source file.
archive.body:
## Role

Astral Vanguards are travelers, scouts, historians, archivists, preservers, witnesses, and intruders. Unlike the alien principles, they do not pressure reality from beneath. They move across expressions and learn to recognize the pattern.

## Central tension

Does seeing the pattern create responsibility—or the most dangerous kind of confidence? Saving, preserving, and interpreting can all become forms of control when consent disappears.

archive.title: Bizi
archive.summary: Sacred infrastructure: routes, fuel, maintenance, and access transformed into metaphysics.
archive.provenance: Strong concept kernel; visual and historical execution requires transformation.
archive.body:
## Concept kernel

Bizi treats maintenance as prayer and movement as participation in a sacred system. Whoever controls the route, fuel, or Hub controls access and legitimacy.

Its strongest reusable question is: **when a society depends on a system completely, can it afford to tell the truth about that system?**

## Distinction

Bizi routes, powers, connects, repairs, schedules, and creates dependency. Its identity should not collapse into Sheen's memory and inheritance systems.

archive.title: Competitive Circuit Proposal
archive.summary: A product-strategy draft with paid-only progression and unsupported legal claims requiring replacement or major rewrite.
archive.provenance: Archived PDF reviewed during the Archive Diagnostic.
archive.body:
## Why it remains in the archive

This proposal records an important product experiment and the tensions it revealed. It should be preserved as strategy history, not silently discarded.

## Why it must not guide implementation

K-XP from paid events is required for major qualification, paid participation becomes a proxy for legitimacy, and the document calls the structure legally clean without qualified review. Those elements contradict the player-first direction.

archive.title: Compounding Pressure
archive.summary: A growth pattern where small advantages multiply, balanced by visible overextension and counterplay.
archive.provenance: Mechanic translation extracted from Zynarth's competitive snowball language.
archive.body:
## Skill test

The player must know when to convert momentum and when further growth becomes overextension.

Healthy versions expose thresholds, costs, and counterplay. A mechanic that merely makes the current leader increasingly impossible to challenge expresses Zynarth's failure mode without becoming a good game system.

archive.title: Designer Ethics Codex
archive.summary: The current fiction and commentary ethics guidance, valuable but contradicted by direct historical transcription.
sourceArtifacts: Archive/Prose/THE EGGS MS WHOLISTIC DESIGNER ETHICS CODEX.pdf
archive.provenance: Archived PDF reviewed during the Archive Diagnostic.
archive.body:
## Durable direction

Transform rather than transcribe. Critique systems rather than vulnerable people. Use fiction to illuminate reality without reenacting human trauma or relying on direct real-world symbols.

## Open problem

The current civilization timelines closely follow Rome, the French Revolution, Byzantium, and imperial China. The codex needs operational checks, and the timelines need transformation or explicit reclassification.

archive.title: Archive Foundation
archive.summary: The operating contract that keeps the archive reusable across games without forcing literal lore repetition.
archive.provenance: Synthesized from the Archive Diagnostic and Foundation Specification.
archive.body:
## What this archive is

The EGGS / Para archive is an evergreen creative systems library. It preserves symbolic pressures, thematic questions, mechanical patterns, aesthetic motifs, player identities, competitive meanings, and project-specific expressions.

It is not one finished story, one game's lore bible, or a requirement that every game reproduce the same factions literally.

> Alien principles define pressures on what can happen. Mortal expressions show how those pressures feel when embodied in a world, institution, game, or player experience.

## Reuse standard

A future game should document at least one material derivation from the archive. That derivation may be explicit lore, a visible system, an aesthetic pattern, symbolic language, or hidden mechanical logic. Copying only a name, color, or emblem is not meaningful reuse.

Projects may intentionally omit principles that do not improve the game.

archive.title: Frumo
archive.summary: A frozen revolution where legitimate grief becomes authority, theater, and eventually another throne.
archive.provenance: Strong concept kernel; current timeline remains project-specific and needs transformation.
archive.body:
## Concept kernel

Frumo is an emotional weather system. A wounded people build solidarity through remembered injustice, then discover that institutions fed by pain require the wound to remain open.

Its strongest reusable question is: **how long can a people live on righteous grief before grief becomes another throne?**

## Rewrite boundary

Preserve frozen futurity, grief as legitimacy, tribunals, revolutionary purity, and fear of healing. Replace the French Revolutionary sequence and one-to-one historical figures.

archive.title: Creative Asset System Index
archive.summary: The current inventory workbook: useful as a migration scaffold, insufficient as the final domain model.
archive.provenance: Existing organizational scaffold inspected during the Archive Diagnostic.
archive.body:
## Keep

The master inventory, browsable views, controlled labels, subject/faction filtering, and direct links to source files.

## Change

Use stable IDs and checksums, workspace-relative paths, typed entity relationships, separate canon and review state, and provenance/rights fields. The `assets` sheet should remain a generated view rather than a second source of truth.

archive.title: Morphlings
archive.summary: Embodied hybrid expressions produced where alien principles overlap and categories fail.
archive.provenance: Current direction narrowed from an overloaded source definition.
archive.body:
## Working definition

A Morphling gives a convergence a body, identity, group, or stable form. Morphlings are not generic shapeshifters, miscellaneous mutants, or arbitrary mixtures.

Every Morphling should identify its source convergence, embodiment logic, stable and variable traits, narrative role, and mechanical affordance.

## Why they matter

They prevent the system from becoming a chart of pure teams. They make translation, contradiction, inheritance, and mixed belonging visible.

archive.title: Para Poker
archive.summary: A proposed competitive application centered on reads, pressure, identity, and incomplete information—not wagering.
archive.provenance: Product boundary synthesized from user direction and diagnostic criticism.
archive.body:
## Product premise

Para Poker should use poker's durable competitive meanings—reads, pressure, incomplete information, identity, history, and rivalry—without importing deposits, wagering, rake, cash-equivalent chips, or paid competitive power.

## Current caution

The archived competitive circuit requires paid-only K-XP for major qualification and makes unsupported claims of legal safety. That document is a risky product-strategy artifact, not an implementation specification.

archive.title: Pressure Field
archive.summary: Small repeated marks accelerating toward a shared mass without defaulting to insect imagery.
archive.provenance: Conceptual motif awaiting art-source audit and visual grammar approval.
archive.body:
## Behavior

Many small marks begin independently, then align, accelerate, and become visually difficult to separate. The motif may appear through animation, borders, map pressure, or achievement frames.

It should avoid making insects the default visual shorthand for Zynarth.

archive.title: Reath
archive.summary: Provisional project scope for the developed mortal civilizations, timelines, and associated visual archive.
archive.provenance: Provisional scope created to prevent world-specific lore from binding all EGGS games.
archive.body:
## Provisional role

Reath currently functions as the safest scope for Rumin, Frumo, Bizi, Sheen, their characters, timelines, and locations. This prevents those materials from silently becoming ecosystem-wide foundation canon.

Its relationship to Paralleon, Para, and EGGS still requires a user decision.

archive.title: The Returning Tide
archive.summary: A resilience achievement for turning repeated losing positions into earned competitive recovery.
archive.provenance: Prototype example created to test meaningful achievement translation.
archive.body:
## Earned meaning

Awarded for demonstrating persistence and adaptation—not for purchasing attempts or grinding trivial participation.

The exact criteria belong to each project, but the achievement should preserve evidence of the matches or season that earned it.

archive.title: Rumin
archive.summary: Empire as appetite made respectable: conquest converted into contracts, credit, and civic order.
archive.provenance: Strong concept kernel; current timeline remains project-specific and needs transformation.
archive.body:
## Concept kernel

Rumin is procedural appetite: extraction presented as public order, conquest translated into paperwork, and obligation made beautiful enough to feel inevitable.

Its strongest reusable question is: **when does order stop protecting life and start owning it?**

## Rewrite boundary

Preserve finance, civic spectacle, debt, roads, legal legibility, and respectable appetite. Replace the one-to-one Roman event sequence, rulers, symbols, and institutional copies before project-canon promotion.

archive.title: Sheen
archive.summary: Rooted memory: continuity, healing, inherited duty, and preservation becoming control.
archive.provenance: Strong concept kernel; governance and historical execution need transformation.
archive.body:
## Concept kernel

Sheen imagines history as rings in wood: continuity makes life bearable, but inherited memory can become a cage that teaches each new branch how it is permitted to grow.

Its strongest reusable question is: **what do we owe the past, and when does that debt become a cage?**

## Distinction

Sheen remembers, inherits, heals, legitimizes, and preserves. Its identity should not collapse into Bizi's routing and infrastructure systems.

archive.title: Signal Reader
archive.summary: A player who interprets unstable information early and changes plans without becoming trapped by certainty.
archive.provenance: Prototype archetype translating Zendra into a constructive player promise.
archive.body:
## Player promise

You notice what a changing situation is trying to say before others do.

Signal Reader describes observable play—selective bluffing, adaptation, and information discipline. It must not label a player paranoid, manipulative, delusional, or morally suspect.

archive.title: Voltari × Zendra
archive.summary: Regulated perception: belief encoded into rules, rituals, interfaces, and institutions.
archive.provenance: Extracted from Morphling examples and Bizi/Sheen expressions.
archive.body:
## Synthesis

Dream becomes law. Interpretation acquires protocol. A shared symbolic world is made reproducible through ritual, architecture, education, or interface.

Its constructive possibility is common meaning maintained carefully. Its destructive form is propaganda that no longer looks like persuasion because it has become infrastructure.

## Mechanical direction

Rule prediction, ritual sequences, declared information, controlled reveals, and systems that reward reading how others interpret the same signal.

archive.title: Voltari
archive.summary: Order before government: sequence, rank, procedure, control, and the promise that everything can function.
archive.provenance: Synthesized from current alien-principle prose.
archive.body:
## Core question

What is lost when everything finally functions?

Voltari translates messy life into legible systems: grids, schedules, ranks, laws, protocols, architecture, and reliable rules.

## Constructive expression

Discipline, fairness, coordination, mastery, stable memory, and dependable structures that make meaningful competition possible.

## Failure mode

The spontaneous becomes an error. Difference becomes inefficiency. A system designed to protect life begins correcting everything that cannot fit it.

## Mechanical vocabulary

Arrange, rank, sequence, constrain, optimize, standardize, defend, and execute.

archive.title: Zendra
archive.summary: Perception, influence, signal interpretation, and the point where meaning changes possible action.
archive.provenance: Synthesized from Zendra principle prose and the Xen'Dra observer poem.
archive.body:
## Core question

What is real once enough minds obey it?

Zendra is the inner battlefield: attention, interpretation, prediction, memory, art, propaganda, empathy, belief, and mistrust.

## Constructive expression

Imagination, empathy, insight, reframing, artistic transformation, and the ability to read unstable situations.

## Failure mode

Fear becomes evidence. Symbols become commands. A population acts on ghosts because shared meaning has become heavier than observable reality.

## Mechanical vocabulary

Reveal, conceal, predict, bluff, misread, reframe, signal, and distort.

archive.title: Zynarth × Voltari
archive.summary: Organized appetite: multiplication given lanes, procedure, infrastructure, and rank.
archive.provenance: Extracted from Morphling examples and the Rumin expression.
archive.body:
## Synthesis

A swarm learns bureaucracy. Consumption becomes procedural. Growth acquires standards, routes, ledgers, and enforcement.

Its constructive possibility is coordinated scale: many actors sharing reliable infrastructure. Its destructive form is extraction so organized that no individual action appears responsible.

## Mechanical direction

Engine building, production chains, formation swarms, escalating economies, and the tension between efficient growth and overextension.

archive.title: Zynarth × Zendra
archive.summary: Contagious meaning: fear, hope, grief, or myth multiplying through attention and bodies.
archive.provenance: Extracted from Morphling examples and the Frumo expression.
archive.body:
## Synthesis

A rumor becomes an organism. An emotion gains momentum because every witness becomes a carrier.

Its constructive possibility is inspiration, shared courage, and distributed imagination. Its destructive form is panic or grievance that feeds by reproducing itself.

## Mechanical direction

Viral objectives, chain reactions, social deduction, copied states, contagious buffs, and pressure created by uncertain shared information.

archive.title: Zynarth
archive.summary: Pressure, appetite, multiplication, and the moment quantity becomes destiny.
archive.provenance: Current direction normalized from mixed Zynarth/Xynarth source spelling.
archive.body:
## Core question

What happens when more becomes unstoppable?

Zynarth is not merely insects, monsters, or biological horror. It is the logic of accumulation: repetition, compounding advantage, crowd force, appetite, survival, and collective action.

## Constructive expression

Resilience, adaptation, solidarity, and the ability of many small actors to challenge concentrated power.

## Failure mode

Need becomes appetite. Growth continues because growth worked before. Responsibility is distributed until no one feels accountable for the flood.

## Mechanical vocabulary

Multiply, compound, consume, recover, spread, recruit, overwhelm, and overextend.

remediation.title: Resolve ecosystem name hierarchy
remediation.problem: EGGS, Para, Paralleon, Reath, Mythic Strategies, Egghead University, and the competitive circuit are used as brands, worlds, products, and community spaces without one stable relationship model.
remediation.why: Future records and projects cannot be scoped reliably if “world,” “game,” “brand,” and “community” are interchangeable.
remediation.affected: `Index/readme.txt`; `Archive/Prose/EGGS MDP (1).pdf`; `Archive/Prose/THE EGGS MS WHOLISTIC DESIGNER ETHICS CODEX.pdf`; all project records.
remediation.fix: Draft a one-page hierarchy defining owner brand, creative universe, setting, game/product, community program, and commercial venue. Record aliases and deprecated uses.
remediation.output: Approved ecosystem map and glossary entries.

remediation.title: Separate “faction” into precise entity types
remediation.problem: “Faction” currently refers to alien principles, mortal civilizations, player identities, organizations, and browsing categories.
remediation.why: This flattening obscures the system's strongest distinction and will produce confused app data and player messaging.
remediation.affected: All `what are *.txt` files; `alien principle.txt`; index `Faction` column; future faction pages.
remediation.fix: Define controlled subtypes: alien principle, mortal civilization, organization, player affiliation, and project faction. Keep “Faction” only as an optional umbrella label in UI.
remediation.output: Controlled vocabulary and migration mapping for current faction labels.

remediation.title: Normalize core term spellings and aliases
remediation.problem: The archive uses Zynarth/Xynarth and Zendra/Xen’Dra inconsistently; other names also vary in capitalization.
remediation.why: Naming drift breaks search, relationships, data imports, and player recognition.
remediation.affected: `what are xynarth.txt`; `what are zendra.txt`; `zendrapoem.txt`; `what are morphlings.txt`; diagnostic and foundation documents.
remediation.fix: Create a canonical-name and alias registry. Preserve original spellings inside source artifacts but normalize indexed entities and search aliases.
remediation.output: Approved naming decision and alias table.

remediation.title: Define minimum meaningful archive reuse
remediation.problem: Every EGGS game should draw from the archive, but the threshold between meaningful derivation and decorative reference is unclear.
remediation.why: Without a test, the archive will either be forced into every project or reduced to cosmetic name-dropping.
remediation.affected: `Index/readme.txt`; `ARCHIVE_FOUNDATION_SPEC.md`; all future project briefs.
remediation.fix: Require each project to document at least one material derivation with a source concept, translation mode, player promise, and evidence. Permit intentional omissions.
remediation.output: Project reuse checklist and approval criterion.

remediation.title: Define boundaries of the three-principle grammar
remediation.problem: The principles are described as always present and as defining what can happen, which risks making the system totalizing and unfalsifiable.
remediation.why: Designers need freedom to use one principle, omit a principle, or recognize influences outside the triad.
remediation.affected: `alien principle.txt`; all alien-principle files; `ARCHIVE_FOUNDATION_SPEC.md`.
remediation.fix: Add explicit non-claims: principles are interpretive/design lenses, not mandatory explanations; `not applicable` and intentional absence are valid.
remediation.output: Foundation clarification and examples of valid partial use.

remediation.title: Classify every current prose and PDF artifact
remediation.problem: Raw notes, polished essays, ethics guidance, product strategy, and project lore currently sit together without authority labels.
remediation.why: File presence may be mistaken for canon or approved product policy.
remediation.affected: All files in `Archive/Prose`; `Index/readme.txt`.
remediation.fix: Assign each artifact a layer, authority status, review flags, project scope, and short rationale. Default to flexible inspiration or experimental unless explicitly approved.
remediation.output: Artifact classification table covering every prose/PDF file.
remediation.needsDecision: No for provisional classification; Yes for canon promotion

remediation.title: Separate authority status from review state
remediation.problem: “Canon,” “risky,” “contradictory,” and “needs decision” are being treated as one kind of status.
remediation.why: A concept can be strong direction and risky at the same time; one field cannot express both accurately.
remediation.affected: Current index `Status`; future schemas; all archive entities.
remediation.fix: Store `authority_status` separately from `review_flags`, using the enums in `ARCHIVE_FOUNDATION_SPEC.md`.
remediation.output: Approved status matrix and legacy-status migration rules.

remediation.title: Establish canon promotion and retirement workflow
remediation.problem: No process defines how material becomes foundation canon, project canon, or retired material.
remediation.why: Unreviewed drafts can harden into canon, while rejected ideas may disappear without context.
remediation.affected: Entire archive; future app workflows.
remediation.fix: Define approvers, evidence requirements, mandatory decision-log fields, supersession behavior, and restrictions on silent reactivation.

remediation.title: Mark superseded and duplicate formulations
remediation.problem: `what are morphlings.txt` contains repeated and expanded formulations, while other concepts recur with wording differences and no version chain.
remediation.why: Designers cannot tell which statement is current or whether differences are meaningful.
remediation.affected: `what are morphlings.txt`; alien-principle prose; future successor drafts.
remediation.fix: Extract concept statements into versioned records, mark duplicates, and link superseded passages without deleting sources.
remediation.needsDecision: No, unless choosing the authoritative formulation

remediation.title: Create project-scope boundaries for current lore
remediation.problem: Rumin, Sheen, Bizi, Frumo, Reath, and their timelines are not consistently marked as project-specific.
remediation.why: A setting-specific history may accidentally bind unrelated future games.
remediation.affected: All civilization descriptions and timelines; associated art folders.
remediation.fix: Create a provisional Reath/Paralleon project scope and place current civilizations, characters, and timelines inside it pending hierarchy approval.
remediation.needsDecision: Yes for final scope; No for provisional tagging

remediation.title: Build a faction distinction matrix
remediation.problem: Factions are described richly but not compared through consistent attributes.
remediation.why: Overlap becomes visible only in prose review, and designers lack a reusable differentiation tool.
remediation.affected: All principle and civilization descriptions.
remediation.fix: Compare each entity by core pressure, signature verbs, constructive promise, failure mode, institutions, mechanics, player fantasy, motifs, and exclusions.
remediation.needsDecision: No for draft; Yes for approval

remediation.title: Define positive player-facing identity for every faction-like entity
remediation.problem: Current descriptions emphasize critique and horror more clearly than honorable identification.
remediation.why: Players cannot safely identify with a label that reads primarily as authoritarian, consumptive, or delusional.
remediation.affected: Zynarth, Voltari, Zendra; Rumin, Sheen, Bizi, Frumo; onboarding material in `EGGS MDP (1).pdf`.
remediation.fix: Add an aspirational promise, admired skills, healthy competitive behavior, shadow risk, and non-accusatory profile language to each entity.

remediation.title: Replace single-faction onboarding with layered affinities
remediation.problem: The MDP suggests choosing a faction, while the creative system says identity is positional and mixed.
remediation.why: A single-team model contradicts the archive's strongest identity idea.
remediation.affected: `Archive/Prose/EGGS MDP (1).pdf`; future profiles and onboarding.
remediation.fix: Design an affinity model supporting primary, secondary, evolving, or project-specific identities without compulsory allegiance.
remediation.output: Affinity model and revised onboarding copy.

remediation.title: Define mechanical signatures rather than color/team signatures
remediation.problem: Faction reuse can collapse into names, emblems, or palettes without meaningful behavior.
remediation.why: Cosmetic factioning becomes repetitive and forced across games.
remediation.affected: Principle pages; achievement/card concepts; future game briefs.
remediation.fix: Assign each principle and approved expression reusable verbs, resource dynamics, skill tests, and anti-patterns.
remediation.needsDecision: No for drafting; Yes for canon approval

remediation.title: Rewrite Zynarth as a complete design principle
remediation.problem: Zynarth is strong conceptually but weighted toward plague, greed, mob behavior, and runaway snowballing.
remediation.why: It needs a durable constructive identity and balanced mechanical applications.
remediation.affected: `what are xynarth.txt`; `alien principle.txt`; Morphling examples.
remediation.fix: Produce a canonical-format brief covering core question, verbs, virtues, healthy play fantasy, failure modes, mechanic patterns, exclusions, and cross-genre examples.

remediation.title: Rewrite Voltari as a complete design principle
remediation.problem: Voltari is clear but can collapse into generic robot order or authoritarian bureaucracy.
remediation.why: Its positive value—reliability, fairness, discipline, and meaningful rules—must remain usable in competitive design.
remediation.affected: `what are voltari.txt`; `alien principle.txt`; Bizi, Sheen, and Rumin descriptions.
remediation.fix: Define precise verbs, constructive competitive expressions, failure modes, exclusions, and genre-independent uses.

remediation.title: Rewrite Zendra with concrete mechanical verbs
remediation.problem: Zendra is narratively memorable but mechanically less defined and can become generic psychic magic.
remediation.why: Reuse across games requires specific player decisions and information structures.
remediation.affected: `what are zendra.txt`; `zendrapoem.txt`; Morphling examples.
remediation.fix: Define verbs such as reveal, conceal, predict, misread, reframe, bluff, and alter interpretation; distinguish information from supernatural spectacle.
remediation.output: Zendra principle specification and mechanic map.

remediation.title: Resolve Voltari “signal” versus Zendra interpretation
remediation.problem: Both principles claim signal-related territory.
remediation.why: Unresolved semantic overlap will blur mechanics, motifs, and hybrid logic.
remediation.affected: `what are voltari.txt`; known Zendra direction; foundation documents.
remediation.fix: Assign Voltari transmission protocol, standardization, and legibility; assign Zendra reception, interpretation, meaning, and distortion. Test edge cases.
remediation.output: Boundary note with examples and `should_not_be_confused_with` links.

remediation.title: Define principle absence, resistance, and agency
remediation.problem: The current cosmology gives little formal room for refusal, chance, or events that resist dominant pressures.
remediation.why: Without resistance, the principles can feel deterministic and narratively airless.
remediation.affected: `alien principle.txt`; Astral Vanguard concept; future game translations.
remediation.fix: Define how actors resist, redirect, balance, or remain unreadable to a principle without inventing another principle prematurely.

remediation.title: Approve Convergence as the abstract hybrid layer
remediation.problem: “Morphling” currently names abstract combinations, beings, identities, and design classifications.
remediation.why: One overloaded term makes schemas and lore ambiguous.
remediation.affected: `what are morphlings.txt`; foundation specification; all hybrid examples.
remediation.fix: Use Convergence for abstract combinations and Morphling for embodied expressions, subject to approval.

remediation.title: Create the three pairwise convergence specifications
remediation.problem: The combinations have evocative phrases but no consistent design records.
remediation.why: They are among the most reusable ideas in the archive and need more than examples.
remediation.affected: `what are morphlings.txt`; Rumin, Sheen, Bizi, and Frumo mappings.
remediation.fix: Specify Zynarth–Voltari, Voltari–Zendra, and Zynarth–Zendra using combined verbs, constructive forms, destructive forms, mechanics, motifs, and exclusions.

remediation.title: Define triple-convergence limits
remediation.problem: Triple hybrids are described as “even stranger,” but their design value and constraints are undefined.
remediation.why: An all-principle category can become a convenient explanation for anything.
remediation.affected: `what are morphlings.txt`.
remediation.fix: Define when a triple convergence is justified, what it must demonstrate, and why it is not merely a pile of traits.
remediation.output: Triple-convergence rule and one approved example.

remediation.title: Create a Morphling validation template
remediation.problem: There is no quality test preventing generic shapeshifters or arbitrary mixed creatures from being labeled Morphlings.
remediation.why: Weak Morphlings would rapidly dilute the core hybrid system.
remediation.affected: Future characters, cards, factions, and player identities; `what are morphlings.txt`.
remediation.fix: Require component convergence, embodiment logic, stable and variable traits, narrative role, mechanical affordance, and explicit non-generic distinction.
remediation.needsDecision: No for draft; Yes for adoption

remediation.title: Establish Astral Vanguards as a separate ontological layer
remediation.problem: Astral Vanguards are presented alongside alien factions despite serving as outsiders and interpreters rather than principles.
remediation.why: Treating them as a fourth faction breaks the layer model.
remediation.affected: `what are morphlings.txt`; `EGGS MDP (1).pdf`; future Vanguard records.
remediation.fix: Define them as cross-world roles or entities linked to projects, interventions, and observations—not as a principle.
remediation.output: Astral Vanguard foundation brief and data subtype.
